# sqlite-vec

Pinned upstream source: [asg017/sqlite-vec v0.1.6](https://github.com/asg017/sqlite-vec/tree/v0.1.6).
`sqlite-vec.c` Git blob: `d8490cd02954dc529d8d282c9650ad8973b56f4f`.
The header is generated from the upstream `sqlite-vec.h.tmpl` with version 0.1.6.
The MIT license is preserved in LICENSE-MIT. The C source is unmodified.

Built statically with the SQLx SQLite headers, filesystem functions omitted. Each kernel
connection registers this extension directly; arbitrary extension loading stays disabled.
